title: Westinghouse Lighting Recalls Outdoor Ceiling Fans Due to Impact Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fan blades can crack and break, posing an impact injury hazard. Units: About 3,000.

title: CB2 Recalls Bordo Dining Tables Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The table legs can become unsteady when moved, causing the table to collapse, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 1,120.

title: Endliss Technology Recalls Trianium Battery Phone Cases Due to Burn Hazard; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com
summary: The lithium-ion battery in the cases can overheat resulting in thermal runaway, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 367,000.

title: Harbor Breeze Kingsbury Ceiling Fans Recalled by HKC-US Due to Impact and Laceration Injury Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Lowe's Stores
summary: The light globe can fall from its housing, posing an impact and laceration injury hazards. Units: About 280,000.

title: Prestone Products Recalls Antifreeze Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirements; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The antifreeze products contain the substance ethylene glycol which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. title: Rocky Mountain Oils Recalls Wintergreen Essential Oil and Oil Blends Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The products contain the substance methyl salicylate which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The packaging of the products is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 33,000.

title: Bed Bath & Beyond Recalls SALT Lounge Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The locking mechanism on the chair frame can disengage, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 10,000 (In addition, about 330 were sold in Canada).

title: CB2 Recalls Trace Bookcases Due to Risk of Collapse; Injury Hazard to Consumers
summary: The bookcase frame can collapse when fully loaded, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 400 (in addition seven units were sold in Canada).

title: Crate and Barrel Recalls Danish Tall Bookcases Due to Risk of Collapse; Injury Hazard to Consumers
summary: The bookcase can collapse when fully loaded, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 2,100.

title: Jakks Pacific Recalls to Repair Morfboard® Skate & Scoot Scooters Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The "Y" handlebar joint on the scooter can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 162,300.

title: Peloton Recalls PR70P Bike Pedals Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: PR70P Clip-In Pedals can break unexpectedly during use, causing laceration injuries. Units: About 27,000 bikes (54,000 pedals).

title: Sales BSD Recalls Homerygardens Extension Cord Splitters Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The wire size of the recalled extension cords cannot handle the appropriate amp load and lacks protective features, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,700.

title: Gorilla Commerce Recalls Oven Liners Due to Risk of Carbon Monoxide Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: If the oven liner is not cut or configured for the exact specifications of the oven and it is placed over any vents or other openings in the oven, carbon monoxide can build up, posing a risk of carbon monoxide poisoning to consumers. Units: About 1,600.

title: Mueller Austria Recalls Onion Choppers Due to Serious Laceration Hazard
summary: The product's locking tab can detach from the rest of the unit during use, causing hands and fingers to slide into the blades. Units: About 106,000.

title: Serena & Lily Recalls Nash Convertible Cribs Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The leg can become partially detached from the crib's headboard and footboard, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 260.

title: Porter World Trade Recalls Ron Jon Surf Shop Sippy Cup Due to Violations of Federal Lead Content and Phthalates Bans
summary: The plastic characters on the recalled Sippy Cup contain levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban and contain levels of a regulated phthalate that exceed the prohibition of specific phthalates. title: Schneider Electric Recalls Surgeloc™ Surge Protection Devices Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The Surgeloc Surge Protection Device can experience an arc event, which can result in a fire hazard. Units: About 47,250.
